# Akari Codex App Theme

## Installation

Open **Settings → Appearance** in the Codex app, then paste the entire theme string, including the `codex-theme-v1:` prefix, into **Import** for the corresponding theme:

- **Dark theme:** [akari-night.txt](akari-night.txt)
- **Light theme:** [akari-dawn.txt](akari-dawn.txt)

Select **Dark** or **Light** to preview the imported theme if **System** is using the other appearance.

Importing resets the UI and code fonts to the system defaults; choose your preferred fonts after importing.
The themes retain the built-in Codex syntax highlighting and customize the app colors, including diff and skill colors.
